actor_instance: Codex GPT-6, MFM public corpus build
goal: Prevent a public foundation candidate acquisition from silently omitting repository shards while keeping rights admission independent.
procedure: Resolve an exact 40-hex dataset revision; exhaust the recursive paginated repository tree and record every file path, size and verifiable object ID. Require an explicit reviewed include/exclude decision for each file, freezing the full tree and selection hashes. Fetch each included shard from that revision and verify its LFS SHA-256 or Git blob ID. Require exactly one byte-checked receipt per included shard before claiming acquisition coverage. Stage all selected shards into unadmitted row candidates, record held rows, and reconcile exact duplicate and excluded ancestry globally. Separately review file and row grants, PII, removals, contamination, semantic duplicates and adequacy before constructing a training admission.
authority: Code and CPU fixture tests only. No live Hugging Face tree was fetched; no upstream data bytes were admitted, no MFM weights trained, and no GPU route qualified.
validation: Nine focused native corpus tests and six native source-admission tests passed; the 66 existing formation tests and four staging tests also passed. Exact pinned N0 source-manifest bytes match SHA-256 8bfbc11a2974af8f9d03aff558c413dafc699d45743d674a3db0180d17be7c31. Live Hub pagination, real Parquet processing, legal review, Kaggle transfer and foundation-scale performance remain unobserved.
failure_or_lesson: A byte-correct hand-picked shard is not complete source acquisition. Freeze the entire repository tree and require explicit file decisions and complete acquisition receipts; continue to keep that coverage distinct from training rights and model ability.
